scope: Completed archive-first static parsing, hashes and input-index domain counts only. No project execution or numerical mathematical values recomputed.

source_domains.qualification: Raw failures list is initialized but not appended; successful saved run relies on assert F>=0 at every probe. Region/residual classification checked by index only. Certificate signs, zeros and moment identities not recomputed.

prefix_domains.qualification: Input mechanical words and prefix/index domains only. No states, transfer steps or LC/mixed gaps evaluated. Retained record reaches denominator55 with only2failure categories, so earlybreak on3categories was not taken.

grid_domains.qualification: Eight concrete sources and224 finite z/d samples are separate from universal Lean theorem. Only reproduced script/result pair is finalizer-bound; first output lacks script_sha256.

limits: No coefficient, binomial, polynomial, moment, gap or transfer recurrence values recomputed.
All numeric sign/zero/failure results remain saved finite evidence, not independent mathematical verification.
Input words, natural/integer index ranges and finite predicates only; no infinite conclusions inferred from counts.
